notes.subject: math
notes.title: Multiplication Tables
notes.body:
## Multiplication Basics
**Multiplication** is repeated addition.

Example: **3 × 4** = **12**
- **Multiplicand**: 3
- **Multiplier**: 4
- **Product**: 12

## Tables 1-10
**2 × 1 = 2**
**2 × 2 = 4**
**2 × 3 = 6**

__Tip__: Yaad karne ke liye roz practice karo.

notes.subject: science
notes.title: Types of Chemical Reactions
notes.body:
## 5 Types of Reactions

### 1. **Combination**
A + B → AB

### 2. **Decomposition**
AB → A + B

### 3. **Displacement**
A + BC → AC + B

### 4. **Double Displacement**
AB + CD → AD + CB

### 5. **Redox**
__Oxidation-Reduction__ reactions

**Important**: Hamesha balanced equation likho.

notes.subject: physics
notes.title: Coulomb Law
notes.body:
## Coulomb Law
**F = k q₁ q₂ / r²**

- **F** = Force (Newton)
- **k** = 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²
- **q₁, q₂** = Charges (Coulomb)
- **r** = Distance (meter)

### Properties
__Force__ is __inversely proportional__ to **square of distance**.

**Remember**: Same charge → repulsion, Opposite → attraction.

notes.subject: science
notes.title: Speed vs Velocity
notes.body:
## Speed
**Speed** = distance / time

- **Scalar** quantity
- SI unit: **m/s**
- Direction nahi hoti

## Velocity
**Velocity** = displacement / time

- **Vector** quantity
- SI unit: **m/s**
- Direction hoti hai

__Important__: Velocity me direction matter karta hai, speed me nahi.

**Example**:
- Car moving 60 km/h → speed
- Car moving 60 km/h North → velocity

notes.subject: science
notes.title: Types of Reactions
notes.body:
## 5 Types of Reactions

### 1. **Combination**
A + B → AB
Example: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O

### 2. **Decomposition**
AB → A + B
Example: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂

### 3. **Displacement**
A + BC → AC + B
Example: Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu

### 4. **Double Displacement**
AB + CD → AD + CB
Example: NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H₂O

### 5. **Redox**
__Oxidation-Reduction__ reactions

**Remember**: Equations always balance karo.

notes.subject: math
notes.title: Trigonometric Ratios
notes.body:
## Right Triangle Ratios
For angle θ in right triangle:

**sin θ** = Opposite / Hypotenuse
**cos θ** = Adjacent / Hypotenuse
**tan θ** = Opposite / Adjacent

## Standard Values
\| Angle \| sin \| cos \| tan \|
\|-------\|-----\|-----\|-----\|
\| 0°    \| 0   \| 1   \| 0   \|
\| 30°   \| 1/2 \| √3/2\| 1/√3\|
\| 45°   \| 1/√2\| 1/√2\| 1   \|
\| 60°   \| √3/2\| 1/2 \| √3  \|
\| 90°   \| 1   \| 0   \| ∞   \|

__Important__: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

notes.subject: physics
notes.title: Newton's Three Laws
notes.body:
## Newton's First Law (Inertia)
**Ek object apni state me rehta hai** jab tak external force na lage.

- Rest → rest
- Motion → motion

## Newton's Second Law
**F = ma**

- **F** = Force (N)
- **m** = Mass (kg)
- **a** = Acceleration (m/s²)

## Newton's Third Law
**Har action ka equal and opposite reaction hota hai.**

__Example__: Rocket forward jata hai, gas backward push karti hai.

**Remember**: All three laws sirf inertial frame me valid hain.

notes.subject: physics
notes.title: Coulomb Law
notes.body:
## Coulomb's Law
**F = k q₁ q₂ / r²**

- **F** = Force (Newton)
- **k** = 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²
- **q₁, q₂** = Charges (Coulomb)
- **r** = Distance (meter)

### Properties
__Force__ is **inversely proportional** to square of distance.

**Force direction**:
- Same charges → **repulsion**
- Opposite charges → **attraction**

**Note**: Sirf point charges ke liye valid hai.

notes.subject: chemistry
notes.title: Concentration Terms
notes.body:
## Concentration Terms

### 1. **Molarity (M)**
Moles of solute / Liter of solution
**Unit**: mol/L

### 2. **Molality (m)**
Moles of solute / kg of solvent
**Unit**: mol/kg

### 3. **Normality (N)**
Gram equivalents / Liter of solution
**Unit**: N

### 4. **Mole Fraction (x)**
Moles of component / Total moles
__Unitless__ hai

## Relation
Molarity depends on temperature (volume changes)
__Molality__ temperature-dependent nahi hai.

**Remember**: Molarity = Moles / Volume(L)

notes.subject: biology
notes.title: DNA Structure
notes.body:
## DNA Structure

**Watson & Crick** ne 1953 me propose kiya.

### Components
1. **Sugar** - Deoxyribose
2. **Phosphate** group
3. **Nitrogenous bases**:
   - Purines: **Adenine (A)**, **Guanine (G)**
   - Pyrimidines: **Cytosine (C)**, **Thymine (T)**

### Base Pairing Rules
- **A pairs with T** (2 H-bonds)
- **G pairs with C** (3 H-bonds)

### Structure
- **Double helix** (right-handed)
- **Antiparallel** strands
- Width: **2 nm**
- Pitch: **3.4 nm** (10 bp per turn)

__Important__: DNA replication is **semiconservative**.
